title: LongHisDoc: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Chinese Long Historical Document Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2610.14531v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Chinese historical documents are invaluable cultural treasures, but their complexity poses significant comprehension challenges for non-specialists. Despite the success of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) in modern document tasks, their capabilities in Long (full-book) Historical Document understanding remain largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce LongHisDoc, the first benchmark tailored for long historical document understanding. LongHisDoc comprises 1,012 expert-annotated QA pairs derived from 101 PDF documents, with an average of 85.1 pages and 42,776.4 tokens per document. It spans 10 categories and features four QA types: single-page, cross-page, multi-hop, and unanswerable. Answering these questions requires integrating multimodal evidence from text, layout, and visual elements. tldr: 该论文提出了首个针对中文长篇历史文献理解的基准LongHisDoc，包含来自101份PDF文档的1,012个专家标注问答对，评估发现当前最先进的模型准确率均不足70%，揭示了该领域仍有巨大提升空间。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces LongHisDoc, the first benchmark for Chinese long historical document understanding, comprising 1,012 expert-annotated QA pairs from 101 PDF documents, and reveals that even state-of-the-art LLMs and LVLMs achieve less than 70% accuracy, highlighting substantial room for improvement.
